title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
summary: Recent robot foundation models operate with single-step or short-history visuomotor context. We introduce Test-Time-Training Robot Policies (RoboTTT), a robot model and training recipe that scale visuomotor context to 8K timesteps, three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies, without growing inference latency. At this context length, we unlock new robot capabilities: one-shot in-context imitation from human video demonstrations, on-the-fly policy improvement, robustness to perturbations, and stronger performance on multi-stage, long-horizon tasks. We also observe, for the first time, steady gains in closed-loop performance as pretraining context length scales. At its core, RoboTTT integrates Test-Time Training into robot foundation models such as Vision-Language-Action policies, yielding a sequence model whose recurrent state consists of fast weights, parameters updated by gradient descent during both training and inference, compressing histories into weight space and retrieving contextual information for long-context conditioning. To scale training context length, the recipe combines sequence action forcing with truncated backpropagation through time. On challenging real-robot manipulation tasks, RoboTTT improves overall performance by 87% over the single-step context baseline and fully completes a five-minute, ten-stage assembly task, which no baseline ever does. RoboTTT trained with 8K-timestep context outperforms the same model pretrained with 1K timesteps by 62%, suggesting context length as a new scaling axis for robot foundation models. Videos are available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/robottt/
tldr: RoboTTT introduces test-time training to scale visuomotor context for robot policies to 8K timesteps, enabling one-shot imitation, online adaptation, and long-horizon task completion.
tldr_zh: RoboTTT 将测试时训练引入机器人策略，将视觉运动上下文扩展到 8K 时间步，实现单次模仿、在线自适应和长周期任务完成。
summary_zh: 最近的机器人基础模型仅能处理单步或短历史周期的视觉运动上下文。我们提出"测试时训练机器人策略"（RoboTTT），这是一种机器人模型与训练方案，能够将视觉运动上下文扩展至8000个时间步长——比现有最优策略高出三个数量级，且推理延迟不增加。在此上下文长度下，我们解锁了新的机器人能力：通过人类视频演示实现一次性上下文模仿、策略实时改进、对扰动的鲁棒性，以及在多阶段、长周期任务上的更强性能。我们同时首次观察到，随着预训练上下文长度的扩展，闭环性能呈现稳定提升。RoboTTT的核心是将测试时训练集成到视觉-语言-动作策略等机器人基础模型中，形成一种循环状态由快速权重构成的序列模型——这些参数在训练和推理期间通过梯度下降更新，将历史信息压缩到权重空间，并提取上下文信息以处理长上下文条件。为扩展训练上下文长度，该方案将序列动作强制与截断式时间反向传播相结合。在具有挑战性的真实机器人操作任务中，RoboTTT相较单步上下文基线实现了87%的性能提升，并完整完成了一项五分钟、十阶段的装配任务——这是所有基线方法未曾实现的。经8000时间步长上下文训练的RoboTTT，性能比相同模型在1000时间步长预训练时高出62%，这表明上下文长度可作为机器人基础模型的新缩放维度。视频请见https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/robottt/

title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid control requires natural whole-body coordination, precise real-time responses to control signals, and robust generalization across diverse environmental contexts, making it a cornerstone for generalist embodied agents. Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have recently emerged as a promising solution to address these challenges by leveraging large-scale behavioral data to achieve superior expressiveness, versatility and generalization. However, despite growing interest in scaling BFMs to further improve their capabilities, it remains unclear how key factors, including the learning paradigm, behavioral data and model architecture should be coordinated to enable effective scaling. In this work, we revisit the scaling recipe for BFMs and demonstrate that substantial performance gains can be achieved through the coordination of three core components: 1) the learning paradigm of motion tracking that reformulates diverse humanoid control problems as the reproduction of integrated whole-body behaviors in the global frame; 2) the strategic synergy between on-policy rollout quantity and reference motion diversity; and 3) the expressive and scalable model architecture termed Humanoid Transformer that facilitates the natural emergence of structured behavioral representations. Through extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world deployment, we demonstrate that our approach yields significant improvements in control fidelity and task generalization, reducing Mean Per-Keypoint Position Error (MPKPE) on the test set by over 10% in local mode and 82% in global mode compared with existing humanoid controllers. These results establish BFM as a principled and effective foundation for scalable and general-purpose humanoid control.
tldr: This paper proposes a Behavior Foundation Model (BFM) for humanoid robots that scales effectively by coordinating motion tracking as a learning paradigm, synergistic scaling of on-policy data and motion diversity, and the Humanoid Transformer architecture, achieving significant improvements in control fidelity and generalization in simulation and real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于人形机器人的行为基础模型，通过协调运动跟踪的学习范式、在线策略数据与运动多样性的协同扩展以及Humanoid Transformer架构，在仿真和真实部署中实现了控制保真度和泛化能力的显著提升。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
类人控制需要自然的全身协调、对控制信号的精确实时响应，以及跨多种环境场景的鲁棒泛化能力，这使其成为通用具身智能体的基石。行为基础模型（BFM）近期作为一种有前景的解决方案出现，通过利用大规模行为数据实现卓越的表达力、通用性与泛化能力。然而，尽管学界对扩展BFM以进一步提升其能力的兴趣与日俱增，关键因素（包括学习范式、行为数据与模型架构）应如何协同以实现有效的规模化扩展仍不明确。本研究重新审视了BFM的扩展策略，并证明通过协调三个核心组件可实现显著的性能提升：1）运动跟踪的学习范式，将多样化类人控制问题重构为全局框架下全身整合行为的复现；2）在线策略的仿真数据量（rollout）与参考动作多样性之间的战略协同；3）名为Humanoid Transformer的高表达力与可扩展模型架构，其促进了结构化行为表征的自然涌现。通过在仿真与真实世界部署中的大量实验，我们证明该方法在控制保真度与任务泛化能力上取得了显著改进：与现有类人控制器相比，测试集上的每关键点位置平均误差（MPKPE）在局部模式下降低超过10%，全局模式下降低82%。这些结果确立了BFM作为可扩展、通用类人控制基础的原则性与有效性。

title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
summary: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected via UMI devices. Crucially, we develop a scalable auto-labeling pipeline that annotates trajectory clips with natural languages describing scene state transitions, providing rich and precise conditioning for action learning. During post-training, we aim to align these capabilities with robot embodiments and imperative instructions that humans naturally use to prompt robots. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong scaling behavior. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 consistently improves with increased data scales and model sizes during pre-training. This scaling behavior directly transfers to post-training, where a stronger pre-training model yields better out-of-the-box real-robot performance in unseen environments. Furthermore, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 serves as a strong robot foundation policy that can be efficiently fine-tuned on complex, dexterous tasks with high data efficiency. Across multiple simulation benchmarks, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, it establishes a new state-of-the-art with a 57.6% success rate on RoboCasa365, surpassing the previous best of 46.6%. Furthermore, it achieves an average score of 20.07 on RoboDojo, significantly outperforming the prior state-of-the-art (13.07). Code and model checkpoints will be released. Project page: https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-1.html
tldr: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is a foundational VLA model pretrained on over 100k hours of real-world mobile manipulation trajectories, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks and showing strong scaling behavior.
tldr_zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-1是一个基础的视觉-语言-动作模型，在超过10万小时的真实移动操作轨迹上进行预训练，在多个基准测试中达到最先进水平，并展现出强大的扩展行为。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
我们提出小米机器人-1（Xiaomi-Robotics-1），这是一个基础性的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，具备以下能力：（1）在未知环境中开箱即用地遵循多样化语言指令，执行广泛的移动操作任务；（2）仅需极少量微调数据即可高效适应新颖的下游任务。我们提出了一种包含预训练和后训练的两阶段训练方案。在预训练阶段，我们利用通过UMI设备收集的超过10万小时真实世界操作轨迹进行训练，使模型具备广泛且可泛化的动作生成能力。关键地，我们开发了一种可扩展的自动标注流水线，用描述场景状态变化的自然语言对轨迹片段进行注释，为动作学习提供丰富而精确的条件。在后训练阶段，我们旨在使这些能力与机器人本体以及人类自然用于提示机器人的指令性语言对齐。大量实验展示了强大的扩展行为：小米机器人-1在预训练中随着数据规模和模型尺寸的增加持续提升。这一扩展行为直接迁移至后训练阶段，更强的预训练模型在未知环境中实现了更优的开箱即用真实机器人性能。此外，小米机器人-1作为一个强大的机器人基础策略，可在复杂、灵巧的任务上以高数据效率进行高效微调。在多个仿真基准测试中，小米机器人-1超越了现有最先进方法。值得注意的是，它在RoboCasa365上以57.6%的成功率创下新纪录，超越了此前最优的46.6%；在RoboDojo上以20.07的平均得分显著优于此前最优的13.07。代码与模型检查点将予以开源。项目页面：https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-1.html

title: Action QFormer: Structured Representation Shaping under Action Supervision in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Action supervision in vision-language-action (VLA) models is often treated as a downstream objective for learning action prediction. In this paper, we study it instead as a force that shapes inherited multimodal representations. We show that this shaping has a dual effect: it is necessary for forming action-compatible representations, but when action supervision is applied too directly to the inherited multimodal pathway, it can also destabilize representations that support language-side processing and object grounding. To address this tension, we introduce Action QFormer, a query-based action-facing interface that uses instruction-conditioned queries to reorganize inherited multimodal information into action-facing representations before downstream action generation. In zero-shot sim-to-real navigation, Action QFormer improves average closed-loop task success from 18.8% to 56.3%, raises fixed-instruction action-generation correctness from 22.5% to 75.5%, and nearly eliminates out-of-distribution instruction generations. Further analyses show that Action QFormer changes how action supervision shapes inherited multimodal representations, reducing broad upstream rewriting while preserving targeted and sometimes constructive action-supervised adaptation. These results suggest that improving VLA performance requires not only stronger pretrained backbones, but also better ways of selecting and organizing inherited multimodal information while controlling how it is shaped under action supervision.
tldr: This paper proposes Action QFormer, a query-based interface that restructures multimodal representations in VLA models to improve action learning while preserving language and grounding stability, achieving significant gains in zero-shot sim-to-real navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 Action QFormer，一种基于查询的接口，用于重构 VLA 模型中的多模态表征，以改善动作学习同时保持语言和接地稳定性，在零样本仿真到实际导航中取得了显著提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的动作监督通常被视为学习动作预测的下游目标。本文将其作为一种塑造继承多模态表征的作用力进行研究。我们发现这种塑造具有双重效应：一方面对形成与动作兼容的表征至关重要，但当动作监督过于直接地作用于继承的多模态通路时，也可能破坏支持语言端处理与物体接地表征的稳定性。为解决这一矛盾，我们提出Action QFormer——一种基于查询的动作导向接口，该接口利用指令条件查询，在下游动作生成前将继承的多模态信息重组为动作导向表征。在零样本仿真到真实的导航任务中，Action QFormer将平均闭环任务成功率从18.8%提升至56.3%，将固定指令动作生成正确率从22.5%提升至75.5%，并近乎消除了分布外指令的生成。进一步分析表明，Action QFormer改变了动作监督塑造继承多模态表征的方式，在减少广泛上游改写的同时，保留了具有针对性的、有时甚至具有建设性的动作监督适配效应。这些结果表明，提升VLA性能不仅需要更强的预训练骨干网络，更需要更优的方式来选择和组织继承的多模态信息，同时控制其在动作监督下的塑造过程。

title: SoftNav: Injecting 3D Scene Tokens into VLMs for Embodied Navigation
summary: In goal-directed embodied navigation, where an agent must locate a specified target in an unseen environment, 3D scene understanding and navigation reasoning must work in concert. Current approaches transmit 3D scene information to vision-language models (VLMs) through text, suggesting a representation gap in our tested configurations; a controlled ablation confirms that direct embedding-level transfer significantly outperforms the evaluated text serialization formats. We introduce SoftNav, which injects entity-level 3D continuous representations -- one token per detected object or frontier -- into a VLM's hidden space as soft tokens through a lightweight projector. With the 3D encoder and VLM frozen, only ~1,200 samples and ~17M trainable parameters are needed. On HM3D-OVON, SoftNav achieves 74.2%/68.3%/66.7% SR across three splits, surpassing all prior methods in both SR and SPL; the same navigation policy transfers zero-shot to GOAT-Bench (67.2% SR), SG3D (47.2% s-SR), and real-world robot deployment without retraining or architectural modification. Injecting 3D scene tokens directly into VLMs bridges the representation gap, enabling transferable navigation with minimal training.
tldr: SoftNav proposes injecting entity-level 3D continuous tokens directly into a frozen VLM's hidden space via a lightweight projector, enabling transferable embodied navigation with minimal training and achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks and real-world robots.
tldr_zh: SoftNav 提出通过轻量级投影仪将实体级 3D 连续标记直接注入冻结的 VLM 隐藏空间，从而以极少的训练实现可迁移的具身导航，在多个基准测试和真实机器人上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 在目标导向的具身导航中，智能体需在未知环境中定位指定目标，这要求3D场景理解与导航推理协同工作。当前方法通过文本将3D场景信息传递至视觉语言模型，表明我们测试的配置中存在表征鸿沟；一项受控消融实验证实，直接进行嵌入层级传输显著优于所评估的文本序列化格式。我们提出SoftNav方法，通过轻量级投影器将实体级3D连续表征——每个检测到的物体或前沿区域对应一个标记——以软标记形式注入视觉语言模型的隐藏空间。在3D编码器与视觉语言模型均冻结的条件下，仅需约1,200个样本与约1,700万可训练参数。在HM3D-OVON数据集上，SoftNav在三个数据划分上分别取得74.2%/68.3%/66.7%的成功率，在成功率与SPL指标上均超越先前所有方法；相同的导航策略可零样本迁移至GOAT-Bench（成功率67.2%）、SG3D（s-SR 47.2%）及真实机器人部署场景，无需重新训练或修改架构。将3D场景标记直接注入视觉语言模型弥合了表征鸿沟，以最小训练成本实现可迁移的导航能力。

title: FoMoVLA: Bridging Visual Foresight and Motion Guidance for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in visuomotor policy learning, yet remain fundamentally reactive, mapping current observations and language to actions without explicit forward prediction of world dynamics. Existing visual foresight methods predict future visual states but lack explicit motion guidance: they show where to go but not how to get there. We argue that future feature prediction and sparse point tracking are naturally complementary: the former provides the goal state, while the latter captures the continuous motion path toward it. We propose FoMoVLA, a framework that augments VLA representations with explicit spatio-temporal supervision by jointly learning future feature foresight and sparse 2D point tracking, enhancing the continuous action policy. FoMoVLA introduces compact foresight tokens to decode future feature states, decodes sparse temporal 2D point trajectories to model compact geometric motion, and couples both through a lightweight future-conditioned cross-attention module that enables consistent reasoning between anticipated states and point dynamics. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop, and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and strong zero-shot generalization. Project page is available at https://liauto-research.github.io/FoMoVLA.
tldr: FoMoVLA augments VLA models with joint future feature foresight and sparse point tracking to enable explicit motion reasoning, achieving SOTA on multiple robotic manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: FoMoVLA通过联合未来特征预测和稀疏点跟踪来增强VLA模型，使其具备显式运动推理能力，在多个机器人操作基准上达到最优性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在视觉运动策略学习方面取得了显著成果，但其本质上仍是反应式的，即仅将当前观测和语言映射为动作，缺乏对世界动态的显式前向预测。现有的视觉预见方法能够预测未来视觉状态，却缺少显式的运动引导：它们指明了“要去哪里”，但未说明“如何到达”。我们认为，未来特征预测与稀疏点追踪天然具有互补性：前者提供目标状态，后者则捕捉通向该状态的连续运动轨迹。为此，我们提出FoMoVLA框架，通过联合学习未来特征预见与稀疏二维点追踪，以显式时空监督增强VLA表征，从而优化连续动作策略。FoMoVLA引入紧凑的预见标记以解码未来特征状态，解码稀疏时序二维点轨迹以建模紧凑几何运动，并通过轻量级的未来条件交叉注意力模块将两者耦合，实现预期状态与点轨迹动态之间的一致性推理。在LIBERO、RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop及LIBERO-Plus上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了最先进的性能与强大的零样本泛化能力。项目页面可访问：https://liauto-research.github.io/FoMoVLA。

title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
summary: World-action models (WAMs) are emerging as a promising foundation for embodied control: rather than predicting actions alone, they learn representations that couple action generation with future world prediction. This coupling is often viewed as a source of robustness, interpretability, and safety, as a robot's action can in principle be checked against its imagined future. In this paper, we show that this assumption is fragile. We introduce BadWAM, a unified framework for modeling and evaluating World-Action Drift Attacks: a new class of WAM-specific adversarial attacks that use small visual perturbations to break the alignment between what a WAM imagines and what it executes. BadWAM characterizes this attack surface along two natural criteria: attack strength and stealthiness. When the adversary prioritizes disruption, BadWAM instantiates an action-only adversarial attack, which directly drives the model toward task-failing actions. When the adversary additionally prioritizes stealth, BadWAM instantiates an imagination-preserving adversarial attack, which seeks to induce harmful action shifts while keeping the model's predicted future close to its clean imagination. Together, these two attacks capture a spectrum of WAM-specific failures: from overt action hijacking to stealthier cases where the model appears to imagine a plausible future but executes a desynchronized action. We evaluate BadWAM across different variants of WAMs. Results show that our attacks substantially reduce task success rates under closed-loop execution. For example, our action-only attack reduces the model performance from 96.5% to 43.1% success. The results of our imagination-preserving attack further exposes a WAM-specific vulnerability: moderate future-preserving regularization can maintain strong attack performance while reducing future imagination drift.
tldr: This paper introduces BadWAM, a framework for adversarial attacks that target world-action models (WAMs) in embodied control, showing that small visual perturbations can decouple a WAM's imagined future from its executed actions, leading to task failure.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了BadWAM，一个针对具身控制中的世界-动作模型（WAM）的对抗攻击框架，表明微小的视觉扰动能使WAM想象的未来与其执行的动作脱钩，导致任务失败。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（World-action models, WAMs）正成为具身控制领域一个前景广阔的基础范式：这类模型并非单独预测动作，而是学习将动作生成与未来世界预测相耦合的表征。这种耦合通常被视为鲁棒性、可解释性与安全性的来源——机器人原则上可通过其想象中的未来对动作进行校验。本文表明该假设存在脆弱性。我们提出BadWAM，一个用于建模与评估“世界-动作漂移攻击”的统一框架：这是一类针对WAM的特定对抗攻击，通过微小的视觉扰动破坏WAM想象与执行之间的对齐性。BadWAM沿两个自然维度刻画该攻击面：攻击强度与隐蔽性。当攻击者优先考虑破坏效果时，BadWAM实例化一种纯动作对抗攻击，直接驱动模型执行导致任务失败的动作；当攻击者额外追求隐蔽性时，BadWAM实例化一种保想象对抗攻击，旨在诱导有害动作偏移的同时，使模型预测的未来状态接近其清洁想象。这两种攻击共同揭示了WAM特有的失效谱系：从显性的动作劫持，到模型看似想象出合理未来却执行失同步动作的隐蔽场景。我们在不同WAM变体上评估BadWAM。结果表明，在闭环执行条件下，我们的攻击显著降低了任务成功率。例如，纯动作攻击将模型性能从96.5%成功率降至43.1%。保想象攻击的结果进一步暴露了WAM的特定脆弱性：适度的未来保持正则化可在保持强大攻击性能的同时减少未来想象漂移。

title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
summary: Predictive world models enable robots to plan by imagining the outcomes of their actions, but their value for control hinges on generating many rollouts quickly. This creates a bottleneck for diffusion-based world models: multistep sampling makes each rollout expensive, limiting large-scale action search at inference time. We introduce DriftWorld, an action-conditioned world model based on drifting generative models. Rather than denoising iteratively at inference, DriftWorld learns an action-conditioned drift during training, allowing it to generate future frames from the current observation and a candidate action sequence in a single forward pass at 30+ fps, which is 17x faster on average than diffusion based baselines. We evaluate DriftWorld on standard vision-based robotic manipulation benchmarks, including Bridge-V2, RT-1, Language Table, Push-T, and Robomimic. By producing rollouts that are both accurate and fast, DriftWorld achieves state-of-the-art decision-making performance with far less inference time than diffusion-based world model baselines. Beyond online control, DriftWorld can also serve as an offline simulator for ranking real-world robot policies, with rollout-based scores correlating with ground truth at up to 0.99. These results show that drifting models are a strong fit for robot world modeling, where fast, high-quality imagination directly supports planning and policy evaluation.
tldr: DriftWorld introduces an action-conditioned world model using drifting generative models, enabling single-pass generation of future frames at 30+ fps for fast robot planning and policy evaluation.
tldr_zh: DriftWorld 提出了一种基于漂移生成模型的动作条件世界模型，能以 30+ fps 的速度单步生成未来帧，实现快速机器人规划与策略评估。
summary_zh: 预测性世界模型使机器人能够通过想象自身动作的结果来进行规划，但其控制价值取决于快速生成大量轨迹。这给基于扩散的世界模型带来了瓶颈：多步采样使得每条轨迹的生成成本高昂，限制了推理时的大规模动作搜索。我们提出DriftWorld，一种基于漂移生成模型的行动条件世界模型。与推理时迭代去噪不同，DriftWorld在训练过程中学习行动条件漂移，使其能够从当前观测和候选动作序列出发，以30+帧/秒的速度通过单次前向传播生成未来帧，平均速度比基于扩散的基线模型快17倍。我们在标准视觉机器人操控基准（包括Bridge-V2、RT-1、Language Table、Push-T和Robomimic）上评估了DriftWorld。通过生成既准确又快速的轨迹，DriftWorld以远低于基于扩散的世界模型基线模型的推理时间实现了最先进的决策性能。除了在线控制，DriftWorld还可作为离线模拟器用于真实机器人策略排序，其基于轨迹的评分与真实值的相关性高达0.99。这些结果表明，漂移模型非常适合机器人世界建模——快速、高质量的想象能力可直接支持规划与策略评估。

title: Learning Agile Navigation in Crowded Environments for Quadruped Robots
summary: Navigating dynamic and crowded environments presents significant challenges for quadruped robots due to severe sensor occlusion and unpredictable human motion. Existing approaches face a trade-off: model-based methods, such as Velocity Obstacles (VO), theoretically guarantee safety but rely on accurate obstacle motion estimates that often fail in dense crowds, while end-to-end learning methods offer robustness but lack motion prediction capability of obstacles, leading to collisions or conservative behaviors. To solve this, we propose VOP-Nav, a novel navigation system that combines the geometric safety of VO with the agile adaptability of end-to-end learning. Using only local onboard observations, our system avoids explicit obstacle detection and tracking pipelines. The VOP-Net processes multi-frame LiDAR data to implicitly encode dynamic constraints and predict a safe velocity region derived from Velocity Obstacle theory. Importantly, the VO predictions serve a dual role: they are used as input to the navigation policy during inference and as a reward signal during training to encourage safe motion. Evaluations in Isaac Gym demonstrate that VOP-Nav achieves higher success rates than all baselines while balancing locomotion speed and collision avoidance. Real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot further validates the system's robustness and efficiency in complex indoor and outdoor dynamic environments.
tldr: VOP-Nav combines Velocity Obstacle theory with end-to-end learning for quadruped navigation in crowded environments, achieving higher success rates in simulation and real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2.
tldr_zh: VOP-Nav 结合速度障碍理论与端到端学习，实现四足机器人在拥挤环境中的导航，在仿真和真实部署中均取得更高成功率。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
由于严重的传感器遮挡和不可预测的人类运动，四足机器人在动态拥挤环境中导航面临重大挑战。现有方法存在权衡：基于模型的方法（如速度障碍法VO）理论上可保障安全性，但依赖准确的障碍物运动估计，在密集人群中常失效；而端到端学习方法具有鲁棒性，但缺乏障碍物运动预测能力，导致碰撞或保守行为。为此，我们提出VOP-Nav，一种结合VO几何安全性与端到端学习敏捷适应性的新型导航系统。该系统仅利用局部机载观测，避免了显式的障碍物检测与跟踪流程。VOP-Net处理多帧激光雷达数据，隐式编码动态约束并基于速度障碍理论预测安全速度区域。重要的是，VO预测发挥双重作用：既作为推理阶段导航策略的输入，又作为训练阶段的奖励信号以鼓励安全运动。在Isaac Gym中的评估表明，VOP-Nav在平衡运动速度与避障性能的同时，实现了比所有基线方法更高的成功率。在宇树Go2四足机器人上的真实环境部署进一步验证了该系统在复杂室内外动态环境中的鲁棒性与效率。

title: CosFly-VLA: A Spatially Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Tracking
summary: Dynamic target tracking is essential for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) operating in complex urban environments, where both the target and the camera viewpoint change continuously. Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies can track visible targets effectively, but their performance often degrades when buildings, vegetation, or roadside objects block the line of sight. During sustained occlusion, a policy may lose the target state, execute actions toward an incorrect region, and amplify this error through subsequent observations until re-acquisition becomes impossible. To this end, we present CosFly-VLA, a spatially aware VLA model that jointly grounds the target, estimates its visibility, and generates continuous flight actions through a structured prediction interface. To train this policy, we use a large-scale recipe over diverse data sources. Spatially Grounded Continued Pretraining (CPT) on a 500k mixed pool injects UAV-view depth, distance, and 3-D spatial reasoning. A three-stage Curriculum-based Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) process then specializes the tracker through multi-head warm-up followed by two-stage curriculum learning over natural and hard / long-occlusion data. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) training subsequently teaches recovery-oriented reasoning traces before structured answers. Finally, a closed-loop Reinforcement Learning (RL) stage optimizes tracking behavior with a multi-component reward covering stand-off tracking, grounding quality, collision avoidance, and task success. Relative to OpenVLA, CosFly-VLA-0.8B reduces open-loop Average Displacement Error (ADE) by 34.1% on seen-test and 35.3% on unseen-test. Closed-loop optimization improves Success Rate (SR) by 29.8% and 2.5%, respectively. These results demonstrate progress from visible-frame imitation toward spatially grounded action-closed-loop control, evaluated under a shared oracle state history.
tldr: CosFly-VLA introduces a spatially aware vision-language-action model for UAV tracking that maintains target state during occlusion by jointly grounding the target, estimating visibility, and generating flight actions through structured prediction, using continued pretraining, curriculum SFT, chain-of-thought, and closed-loop RL.
tldr_zh: CosFly-VLA 提出了一种空间感知的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于无人机跟踪，通过联合定位目标、估计可见性并在结构化预测接口中生成飞行动作，在遮挡期间维持目标状态。该方法结合了持续预训练、课程式 SFT、思维链和闭环强化学习。
summary_zh: 动态目标跟踪是无人机在复杂城市环境中运行的关键能力，在此类场景中，目标与相机视角均持续变化。现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能有效跟踪可见目标，但当建筑物、植被或路边障碍物遮挡视线时，其性能通常会下降。在持续遮挡过程中，策略可能丢失目标状态，向错误区域执行动作，并通过后续观测放大该误差，直至无法重新捕获目标。为此，我们提出CosFly-VLA——一种具备空间感知能力的VLA模型，能够联合定位目标、估计其可见性，并通过结构化预测接口生成连续飞行动作。为训练该策略，我们采用了涵盖多种数据源的大规模训练方案。首先，在50万规模的混合数据池上进行空间基础持续预训练（CPT），注入无人机视角的深度、距离与三维空间推理能力。随后，通过三阶段基于课程学习的监督微调（SFT）流程，先进行多头预热训练，再针对自然数据与困难/长时遮挡数据开展两阶段课程学习，以此专业化跟踪器。链式思维（CoT）训练进一步在结构化答案输出前教授基于恢复导向的推理轨迹。最后，闭环强化学习（RL）阶段通过多组件奖励函数（涵盖对峙跟踪、基础定位质量、碰撞规避与任务成功）优化跟踪行为。相较于OpenVLA，CosFly-VLA-0.8B在可见测试集与不可见测试集上的开环平均位移误差（ADE）分别降低34.1%与35.3%。闭环优化使成功率（SR）分别提升29.8%与2.5%。这些结果展示了从可见帧模仿向空间基础的动作闭环控制的进展，并在共享的预言状态历史下完成评估。

title: AeroAct: Action-Centered World-Action Models for Language-Conditioned Quadrotor Flight
summary: Language-conditioned quadrotor flight requires a policy to ground semantic goals, anticipate the visual consequences of ego-motion, and output control references that remain smooth and dynamically executable under rapidly changing first-person views. Existing aerial vision-language navigation and vision-language-action methods commonly use discrete actions, high-level waypoints, or instantaneous velocity commands, which provide limited supervision about how flight actions change future observations. We present AeroAct, an action-centered world-action model (WAM) for quadrotor navigation. To the best of our knowledge, AeroAct is the first WAM instantiated and demonstrated for real-world aerial flight. The model adapts a pretrained video diffusion Transformer to predict local trajectory-action chunks from egocentric visual history, proprioception, and language. Future first-person frames are used during training as dense consequence supervision, while deployment directly decodes actions without generating future video. To obtain aligned visual, state, language, and dynamically feasible action data, we build a DiffAero-based pipeline with complementary Isaac Lab and 3D Gaussian splatting renderers. We further introduce a low-cost handheld collection device that couples camera observations with motion estimates to recreate flight-like egocentric trajectories, and a self-guidance procedure that improves temporal consistency across overlapping trajectory chunks. Closed-loop simulation and real-world experiments show that temporal visual context improves target tracking and object-search performance, and that WAM-based policies can be executed on a physical quadrotor.
tldr: AeroAct is the first world-action model (WAM) instantiated for real-world quadrotor flight, adapting a pretrained video diffusion Transformer to predict local trajectory-action chunks from egocentric visual history, proprioception, and language, enabling language-conditioned navigation with smooth, dynamically executable control.
tldr_zh: AeroAct是首个在真实世界四旋翼飞行中实例化的世界动作模型（WAM），它通过适配预训练视频扩散Transformer，从第一人称视觉历史、本体感知和语言中预测局部轨迹-动作片段，实现了语言条件导航的平滑、动态可执行控制。
summary_zh: 语言条件四旋翼飞行需要一种策略，该策略能够理解语义目标、预判自身运动带来的视觉变化，并输出在快速变化的第一人称视角下保持平滑且可动态执行的控制指令。现有的空中视觉-语言导航与视觉-语言-动作方法通常采用离散动作、高层航点或瞬时速度指令，这些方法对飞行动作如何改变未来观测结果提供的监督有限。我们提出AeroAct，一种以动作为中心的世界-动作模型（WAM），用于四旋翼导航。据我们所知，AeroAct是首个在真实空中飞行中得以实例化并验证的WAM。该模型适配了预训练的视频扩散Transformer，从以自我为中心的视觉历史、本体感知和语言中预测局部轨迹-动作块。训练过程中，未来的第一人称帧被用作密集后果监督，而部署时则直接解码动作，无需生成未来视频。为获取对齐的视觉、状态、语言及动态可行动作数据，我们构建了基于DiffAero的流水线，并辅以Isaac Lab和3D高斯泼溅渲染器。我们进一步引入了一种低成本手持采集设备，将相机观测与运动估计相结合，以重现类似飞行的自我中心轨迹，并提出了一种自引导流程，用于改善重叠轨迹块之间的时间一致性。闭环仿真和真实世界实验表明，时间视觉上下文提升了目标跟踪与物体搜索性能，且基于WAM的策略可在物理四旋翼上执行。

title: Steering Robustness into World Action Models via Mechanistic Interpretability and Optimal Control
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable semantically- and physically-informed control but are brittle under distribution shift. In this work, we use mechanistic interpretability to study how robustness-relevant perturbations are represented in WAM activation space. Comparing activations across successful and unsuccessful rollouts, we find some WAM architectures exhibit low-dimensional linear separability for robustness-critical features, while others do not. This motivates the use of contrastive activation directions for training-free WAM steering. We also show that local linearity in WAM activation dynamics enables efficient feedback steering via model-based optimal control, yielding World-Action Linear Quadratic Regulator (WA-LQR), a minimally-invasive reduced-order LQR controller. Via mechanistic evaluations, we predict strong steerability in the Cosmos-Policy and DiT4DiT models but weak steerability in LingBot-VA, consistent with steering intervention results. On Cosmos-Policy and DiT4DiT, WA-LQR generalizes contrastive directions to new tasks and improves robustness to camera, gripper, and visual-noise perturbations over unsteered and prompt steering baselines.
tldr: Uses mechanistic interpretability to analyze robustness in World Action Models, and proposes training-free steering via contrastive activation directions plus a reduced-order LQR controller (WA-LQR) to improve robustness under distribution shift.
tldr_zh: 利用机械可解释性分析世界动作模型的鲁棒性，提出通过对比激活方向进行无训练干预，并采用降阶LQR控制器（WA-LQR）以提升在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）能够实现基于语义与物理信息的控制，但在分布偏移下表现脆弱。本研究采用机制可解释性方法，探究与鲁棒性相关的扰动如何在WAM激活空间中表征。通过对比成功与失败轨迹的激活模式，我们发现部分WAM架构对鲁棒性关键特征呈现出低维线性可分性，而另一些架构则不具备该特性。这促使我们采用对比激活方向实现免训练的WAM引导。研究还表明，WAM激活动态中的局部线性特性可通过基于模型的最优控制实现高效反馈引导，由此提出世界动作线性二次型调节器（WA-LQR）——一种最小侵入性的降阶LQR控制器。通过机制评估，我们预测Cosmos-Policy和DiT4DiT模型具有强可引导性，而LingBot-VA模型的可引导性较弱，该预测与引导干预实验结果一致。在Cosmos-Policy和DiT4DiT模型上，WA-LQR将对比方向泛化至新任务，并在相机、机械爪及视觉噪声扰动下，其鲁棒性优于未引导及提示引导基线方法。

title: Towards Human-like Physical Intelligence: LifelongVision-Language-Action Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Similar to the natural capabilities of humans to sequentially learn new tasks, robots with Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models should possess lifelong learning ability to learn a new task when deployed in open-world environments. However, most recently proposed lifelong learning models aim to effectively learn the current task (plasticity) or maintain high accuracy on previous tasks (stability), while the plasticity-stability trade-off remains largely unsolved in robotic manipulation models. To address this fundamental challenge, we propose a cache-efficient lifelong Vision-Language-Action learning framework for robotic manipulation (i.e., LifelongVLA), which alleviates the plasticity-stability trade-off with a dual-timescale adaptation mechanism while achieving low-cost robotic deployment with a cache-efficient replay strategy. More concretely, we propose a dual-timescale LoRA gating module to decompose VLA adaptation into two lightweight pathways: a short-term adapter for plasticity and a long-term adapter for stable consolidation. These pathways are integrated via a task-aware gate, enabling explicit control of the plasticity-stability trade-off. In the skill replay phase, a cache-efficient stochastic replay strategy is proposed to preserve more balanced retention signals without full-trajectory storage. Finally, experiments show that LifelongVLA outperforms existing baselines, demonstrating efficient skill expansion, robust retention of learned manipulation behaviors, and reduced reliance on retraining for real-world deployment on an xArm robot.
tldr: This paper proposes LifelongVLA, a cache-efficient lifelong Vision-Language-Action learning framework for robotic manipulation that uses a dual-timescale LoRA gating module to balance plasticity and stability, and a stochastic replay strategy to reduce retraining costs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LifelongVLA，一种面向机器人操作的缓存高效终身视觉-语言-动作学习框架，通过双时间尺度LoRA门控模块平衡可塑性与稳定性，并采用随机重放策略降低再训练成本。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
类比于人类顺序学习新任务的自然能力，配备视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的机器人在部署到开放世界环境时，也应具备终身学习能力以掌握新任务。然而，当前大多数终身学习模型旨在有效学习当前任务（可塑性）或保持对先前任务的高精度（稳定性），但在机器人操作模型中，可塑性与稳定性的权衡问题仍未得到根本解决。针对这一核心挑战，我们提出了一种面向机器人操作的高缓存效率终身视觉-语言-动作学习框架（即LifelongVLA），该框架通过双时间尺度自适应机制缓解了可塑性与稳定性的权衡问题，同时借助高缓存效率的回放策略实现了低成本的机器人部署。具体而言，我们提出了一种双时间尺度LoRA门控模块，将VLA自适应分解为两条轻量级路径：用于可塑性的短期适配器与用于稳定巩固的长期适配器。这些路径通过任务感知门控进行集成，从而实现对可塑性与稳定性权衡的显式控制。在技能回放阶段，我们提出了一种高缓存效率的随机回放策略，无需存储完整轨迹即可保留更均衡的保留信号。最后，实验表明LifelongVLA优于现有基线方法，在xArm机器人上实现了高效的技能扩展、对已学习操作行为的稳健保留，以及降低了对真实世界部署中重新训练的依赖。

title: Lights, Camera, Malfunction: When Illumination Robustness Leaves VLA Models Blind to Color
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation; however, their transition to real-world environments reveals vulnerabilities to minor environmental perturbations. We propose FLARE, an optimized physical spotlight attack framework that exploits these vulnerabilities via targeted illuminations, dropping baseline task success rates to zero without any access to model internals. While adversarial training is the standard countermeasure, we identify a critical and previously underestimated defensive pitfall: naive data augmentations incorrectly condition VLA models to discard color as noise, collapsing their visual perception into a purely shape-biased processor. We expose this degradation through a diagnostic grayscale evaluation, in which the defended model maintains high success rates on grayscale inputs, while its success rate on benign, color-dependent real-world tasks drops to at most 47.5%, well below the undefended baseline. To address this, we propose ChromaGuard, a chroma-preserving adversarial training method. On a physical 6-DoF robotic platform, we demonstrate that ChromaGuard achieves 97.5% and 92.5% success rates in benign and attacked color-dependent tasks, respectively.
tldr: FLARE exposes VLA model vulnerabilities via physical spotlight attacks, and ChromaGuard preserves color-dependent task performance during adversarial training.
tldr_zh: FLARE 通过物理聚光灯攻击暴露 VLA 模型的脆弱性，ChromaGuard 在对抗训练中保留颜色相关任务性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用机器人操作的有力范式；然而，它们向真实环境的过渡揭示了其对细微环境扰动的脆弱性。我们提出FLARE——一种优化的物理聚光灯攻击框架，通过定向光照利用这些脆弱性，在无需访问模型内部结构的情况下将基础任务成功率降至零。尽管对抗训练是标准的防御措施，但我们发现了一个此前被低估的关键防御陷阱：朴素的数据增强错误地使VLA模型将颜色视为噪声而加以忽略，导致其视觉感知退化为纯粹的形状偏向处理器。我们通过诊断性灰度评估揭示了这一退化现象——经过防御的模型在灰度输入上保持较高成功率，而在依赖颜色的良性真实世界任务中，其成功率降至至多47.5%，远低于未防御基准线。为解决这一问题，我们提出ChromaGuard——一种保色对抗训练方法。在物理6自由度机器人平台上，我们证明ChromaGuard在良性任务和受攻击的依赖颜色任务中分别达到了97.5%和92.5%的成功率。

title: Reflex: Real-Time VLA Control through Streaming Inference
summary: Flow matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise precise continuous control, but their iterative denoising nature introduces fundamental incompatibilities with real-time robotics: global timestep injection invalidates KV-caching, forcing a choice between slow $O(N^2)$ re-computation or mathematically incorrect cache reuse. We present \textbf{Reflex}, a framework that enables \textit{real-time streaming inference} for flow matching policies by exploiting the \textit{Timestep-Invariance Property} -- that perception encoders are functionally independent of the denoising loop. Reflex partitions the attention context into static, sliding, and dynamic regions, enabling $O(1)$ incremental cache updates while preserving full-batch-equivalent attention outputs for fixed inputs. To ensure stability under continuous high-frequency inference, we introduce \textit{AdaRMSNorm}, an adaptive normalization layer that prevents BFloat16 numerical collapse by gating on flow phase. We further maximize throughput through an \textit{async pipeline} that decouples visual encoding from action generation, combined with \textit{operator fusion} that reduces kernel overhead. On LIBERO and Kinetix benchmarks, Reflex achieves a 2.58$\times$ inference speedup and 50Hz stable streaming, reducing reaction latency by up to 54\% and enabling efficient deployment without performance degradation.
tldr: Reflex enables real-time streaming inference for flow matching VLA models by exploiting timestep-invariance to achieve O(1) cache updates, and introduces AdaRMSNorm and an async pipeline for stable high-frequency deployment, achieving 50Hz inference on robotic benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Reflex利用时间步不变性实现流匹配VLA模型的实时流式推理，达到O(1)缓存更新，并通过AdaRMSNorm和异步流水线实现稳定的高频部署，在机器人基准上达到50Hz推理。
summary_zh: 流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽能实现精确的连续控制，但其迭代去噪特性与实时机器人系统存在根本性不兼容：全局时间步注入使KV缓存失效，迫使人们在缓慢的$O(N^2)$重计算或数学上不正确的缓存复用之间做出选择。本文提出\textbf{Reflex}框架，该框架利用\textit{时间步不变性}（即感知编码器在功能上独立于去噪循环）为流匹配策略实现\textit{实时流式推理}。Reflex将注意力上下文划分为静态区域、滑动区域和动态区域，在保持固定输入的全批等效注意力输出的同时，实现$O(1)$增量缓存更新。为确保连续高频推理下的稳定性，我们引入\textit{AdaRMSNorm}自适应归一化层，该层通过流相位门控机制防止BFloat16数值崩溃。为最大化吞吐量，我们设计了\textit{异步流水线}将视觉编码与动作生成解耦，并采用\textit{算子融合}减少内核开销。在LIBERO和Kinetix基准测试上，Reflex实现2.58倍推理加速与50Hz稳定流式处理，反应延迟降低达54%，且可在无性能退化条件下实现高效部署。

title: MIND-CAVs: Multi-Intelligence Negotiation and Decision System for CAVs based on Intent-Driven Autonomy
summary: Modern autonomous vehicles largely operate as isolated agents: they rely on on-board perception and decision modules and broadcast Basic Safety Messages (BSMs) that expose only low-level kinematic state. While existing cooperative driving frameworks enable limited sensor sharing, they rarely communicate high-level maneuver intentions, and edge computing is primarily used for content delivery rather than decision arbitration. As a result, current connected autonomy lacks a principled mechanism for making globally consistent, intent-aware coordination decisions across vehicles. To address this gap, we propose MIND-CAVs, a Multi-Intelligence Negotiation and Decision framework for connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) based on intent-driven autonomy. Each vehicle abstracts raw sensor observations into structured intent representations, exchanges them over V2X links, and receives globally consistent coordination plans from roadside edge servers. Edge agents combine learned and rule-based arbitration mechanisms to negotiate conflicting intents among vehicles, while a cloud platform records decisions for auditing and continual retraining. We implement MIND-CAVs in a CARLA-based AI-in-the-loop platform and evaluate it in multi-lane highway scenarios involving conflicting maneuvers and route-constrained exits. Experimental results show improved maneuver completion time and reduced unsafe proximity and unnecessary braking compared with isolated autonomy, first-come-first-served arbitration, and multi-agent reinforcement learning baselines.
tldr: MIND-CAVs proposes a multi-intelligence negotiation and decision framework for connected autonomous vehicles where vehicles share structured intent representations over V2X and receive globally coordinated plans from edge servers, reducing unsafe proximity and unnecessary braking.
tldr_zh: MIND-CAVs 提出了一种多智能体协商与决策框架，通过车辆间共享结构化意图表示并经边缘服务器生成全局协调计划，减少了不安全距离和不必要制动。
summary_zh: 现代自动驾驶车辆通常以独立智能体的模式运行：它们依赖车载感知与决策模块，仅广播暴露低层级运动状态的基本安全消息（BSM）。尽管现有协同驾驶框架支持有限的传感器共享，但此类系统极少传递高层级机动意图，且边缘计算主要用于内容分发而非决策仲裁。因此，当前互联自动驾驶系统缺乏一种能够在车辆间实现全局一致且意图感知协调决策的规范化机制。为弥补这一不足，我们提出MIND-CAVs——一种基于意图驱动自主性的网联自动驾驶车辆（CAV）多智能体协商与决策框架。每辆车将原始传感器观测抽象为结构化意图表征，通过V2X链路进行交换，并从路侧边缘服务器获取全局一致的协调方案。边缘智能体结合学习型与规则型仲裁机制来协调车辆间的冲突意图，同时云端平台记录决策结果以供审计与持续再训练。我们基于CARLA仿真环境在包含冲突机动及路线约束出口的多车道高速公路场景中，通过人工智能在环平台实现并评估了MIND-CAVs。实验结果表明，与独立自主驾驶、先到先得仲裁及多智能体强化学习基线方法相比，本方案在缩短机动完成时间、降低危险接近频率及减少非必要制动方面表现更优。

title: Representation-Aligned Tactile Grounding for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
summary: Tactile-enhanced vision-language-action (VLA) policies have been introduced for contact-rich manipulation, where critical interaction states are often hidden from vision. Future tactile prediction is a promising way to use touch because it turns tactile outcomes into supervision for action-induced contact dynamics. Yet VLA policies contain representations with different roles, from perceptual encoding to motor prediction, making it unclear where this supervision should be applied. We study this as a representation-alignment problem. Through a linear probe analysis, we find that future tactile states are most predictable from intermediate action-expert features, rather than from vision-language features or final action states. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a lightweight Latent Tactile Predictor (LTP), which predicts compact future tactile embeddings from the identified intermediate representation. By avoiding direct prediction of noisy raw tactile signals, LTP provides an action-outcome grounding signal that aligns intermediate action representations with future contact consequences. Experiments on real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks show that representation-aligned tactile grounding outperforms less aligned or multi-interface tactile prediction, highlighting the importance of where tactile supervision is applied.
tldr: This paper introduces a Latent Tactile Predictor (LTP) that aligns intermediate action representations with future tactile outcomes to improve tactile-enhanced VLA policies for contact-rich manipulation, demonstrating performance gains on real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种潜在触觉预测器（LTP），通过将中间动作表示与未来触觉结果对齐，来改进触觉增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，并在真实世界的接触密集操作任务中验证了性能提升。
summary_zh: 触觉增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略已被引入用于富含接触的操作任务，其中关键的交互状态通常对视觉隐藏。未来触觉预测是一种有前景的触觉利用方式，因为它将触觉结果转化为对动作引发的接触动力学的监督信号。然而，VLA策略包含从感知编码到运动预测等不同角色的表征，使得这种监督应施加于何处尚不明确。我们将此研究为一个表征对齐问题。通过线性探针分析，我们发现未来触觉状态最易从中间动作专家特征中预测，而非从视觉-语言特征或最终动作状态中预测。基于这一发现，我们引入了一种轻量级潜在触觉预测器（LTP），它从识别出的中间表征中预测紧凑的未来触觉嵌入。通过避免直接预测含有噪声的原始触觉信号，LTP提供了一种动作-结果锚定信号，使中间动作表征与未来接触后果相对齐。在真实世界富含接触的操作任务上的实验表明，表征对齐的触觉锚定优于对齐较弱或多接口的触觉预测，突显了触觉监督施加位置的重要性。

title: Beyond Implicit Force: Evaluating Explicit Force-Torque Proxies in Action Chunking with Transformers
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires policies to infer interaction state from signals that are often weakly observable through vision and kinematics alone. Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) has shown strong performance in fine-grained manipulation, but many deployments collect demonstrations through leader-follower teleoperation, where tracking error between commanded leader motion and executed follower motion implicitly encodes contact, resistance, and constraint violation. This paper examines whether ACT's apparent force-awareness depends on this hidden interaction cue. We introduce an observation-centric ACT variant that predicts future follower joint states instead of leader commands, thereby removing the teleoperation-induced discrepancy signal while preserving the rest of the learning pipeline. We then evaluate whether simple joint-torque proxies, derived from onboard motor current or joint effort, can recover contact-aware behavior without external force/torque sensors. Across four real-world tasks spanning surface following, insertion, stiffness discrimination, and force-based stopping, removing the implicit cue leads to severe failures in force-critical phases. In contrast, torque-augmented policies recover robust contact behavior and improve the base ACT policy. These results demonstrate that, on real hardware, the implicit teleoperation cue is a recoverable source of force-awareness, where torque signals are available, a simple proxy matches, surpasses, or further enhances it.
tldr: This paper shows that ACT policies rely on implicit force cues from leader-follower tracking error, and that simple joint-torque proxies can recover or improve contact-rich manipulation without external force sensors.
tldr_zh: 本文揭示ACT策略依赖主从遥操作跟踪误差中的隐式力信息，并证明简单的关节力矩代理信号可恢复或增强接触丰富的操作能力，无需外部力传感器。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作任务要求策略能够从仅依赖视觉和运动学往往难以充分观测的信号中推断交互状态。基于动作分块的Transformer（ACT）在精细操作中展现了强大性能，但许多实际部署通过主从遥操作收集示教数据，其中主手指令运动与从手执行运动之间的跟踪误差隐式编码了接触、阻力和约束违反信息。本文探究ACT表现出的力感知能力是否依赖于这一隐藏交互线索。我们提出一种以观测为中心的ACT变体，其预测未来从手关节状态而非主手指令，从而消除遥操作引发的差异信号，同时保留其余学习流程。进而评估基于电机电流或关节力矩推导的简单关节力矩代理信号，能否在无外部力/力矩传感器条件下恢复接触感知行为。在涵盖表面跟随、插入、刚度辨别及基于力的停止的四项真实世界任务中，移除隐式线索导致力关键阶段出现严重失败。相反，引入力矩增强的策略能够恢复稳健的接触行为，并提升基础ACT策略的性能。这些结果表明，在真实硬件上，隐式遥操作线索是可恢复的力感知来源——在可获取力矩信号时，简单代理信号能够匹敌、超越或进一步增强该能力。

title: SafeRelBench: A Spatial-Relation-Aware Benchmark for Process-Level Safety in VLM-Driven Embodied Agents
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as the reasoning backbone of embodied agents, enabling robots to interpret visual scenes, follow language instructions, and plan multi-step actions. In household environments, however, safety depends not only on recognizing objects, but also on how actions change the physical scene over time. Existing embodied safety evaluations largely focus on static risk recognition, unsafe instruction refusal, or final-state task completion. As a result, process-level safety failures induced by spatial relations such as support, containment, and proximity remain insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we introduce SAFERELBENCH, a spatial-relation-aware safety benchmark with 507 executable evaluation samples, including 248 spatial-relation samples and 259 non-spatial control samples. Using SAFERELBENCH to evaluate seven open- and closed-source VLM-driven embodied agents, we find a substantial gap between task success and process-level safety compliance: models often complete the requested task while violating process-level safety constraints. Unlike prior benchmarks, SAFERELBENCH explicitly tests whether agents satisfy safety conditions before risk-prone actions, making spatial relations a core dimension in embodied safety assessment. More broadly, our results show that safe embodied intelligence requires not only stronger perception and planning, but also reliable reasoning about how object relations shape risk during interaction.
tldr: Introduces SAFERELBENCH, a benchmark to evaluate process-level spatial-relation safety in VLM-driven embodied agents, revealing that task success often masks safety violations.
tldr_zh: 提出 SAFERELBENCH，用于评估 VLM 驱动具身代理在过程级空间关系安全性的基准，揭示任务成功常掩盖安全违规。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）正日益被用作具身智能体的推理核心，使机器人能够解读视觉场景、遵循语言指令并规划多步骤动作。然而，在家庭环境中，安全性不仅取决于物体识别，还取决于动作如何随时间改变物理场景。现有的具身安全评估主要集中在静态风险识别、不安全指令拒绝或最终状态任务完成上。因此，由支撑、包含、邻近等空间关系引发的过程级安全故障尚未得到充分研究。为填补这一空白，我们提出了SAFERELBENCH——一个空间关系感知的安全基准，包含507个可执行的评估样本，其中248个为空间关系样本，259个为非空间控制样本。使用SAFERELBENCH评估七个开源与闭源VLM驱动的具身智能体后，我们发现任务成功与过程级安全合规之间存在显著差距：模型在完成指定任务的同时，往往违反过程级安全约束。与先前基准不同，SAFERELBENCH明确测试智能体在执行高风险动作前是否满足安全条件，从而将空间关系作为具身安全评估的核心维度。更广泛而言，我们的结果表明，安全的具身智能不仅需要更强的感知与规划能力，还需要对交互过程中物体关系如何塑造风险进行可靠推理。

title: DRIFT: Drift and Aggregation for Motion Planning
summary: End-to-end trajectory planners need to represent multiple plausible driving behaviors while producing a single executable trajectory under real-time constraints. Proposal-based approaches address this ambiguity by generating multiple candidates, but converting the proposal set into a final plan remains a key design problem. We present DRIFT, a fixed-depth planner that combines one-step drifting in a compact trajectory latent space with scene-aware proposal aggregation. Conditioned on features from a pretrained visual encoder, the DRIFT Decoder generates 48 proposal features in a single batched pass, with 32 samples at alpha=0.5 and 16 samples at alpha=0.9. A lightweight Aggregation Head integrates these features with scene, navigation, and ego-state information and directly predicts the final trajectory without requiring trajectory-level quality labels for aggregation. Its output is trained with expert-trajectory imitation and a map-derived boundary regularizer that penalizes waypoints outside the drivable polygon and inside waypoints near its boundary. On NAVSIM navtest, DRIFT achieves 89.6 PDMS and 90.4 EPDMS, with strong drivable-area compliance and ego progress among the methods compared. The proposal-generation and aggregation module runs in 10.82 ms on an NVIDIA RTX 4090, while full-model inference including the visual backbone takes 66.43 ms. These results show that one-step latent proposal generation and direct aggregation provide an efficient design for multi-hypothesis motion planning.
tldr: DRIFT is a fixed-depth motion planner for autonomous driving that generates multiple trajectory proposals via one-step latent drifting and aggregates them with scene awareness, achieving strong drivable-area compliance and real-time performance.
tldr_zh: DRIFT 是一种用于自动驾驶的固定深度运动规划器，通过一步潜在漂移生成多个轨迹候选，并结合场景感知进行聚合，实现了良好的可行驶区域合规性和实时性能。
summary_zh: 端到端轨迹规划器需要在实时约束下生成单一可执行轨迹的同时，表征多种合理的驾驶行为。基于提议的方法通过生成多个候选方案来处理这种歧义性，但如何将提议集合转化为最终规划仍是一个关键设计问题。我们提出DRIFT，这是一种固定深度规划器，将紧凑轨迹潜在空间中的单步漂移与场景感知的提议聚合相结合。基于预训练视觉编码器的特征条件，DRIFT解码器通过单次批处理生成48个提议特征，其中32个样本处于α=0.5，16个样本处于α=0.9。轻量级聚合头将这些特征与场景、导航及自车状态信息整合，直接预测最终轨迹，无需依赖轨迹级质量标签进行聚合。其输出通过专家轨迹模仿和地图衍生边界正则化器进行训练，该正则化器对可行驶多边形外的航点及靠近其边界的内部航点施加惩罚。在NAVSIM navtest上，DRIFT达到89.6 PDMS和90.4 EPDMS，在对比方法中表现出较强的可行驶区域合规性与自车进程表现。提议生成与聚合模块在NVIDIA RTX 4090上运行时间为10.82毫秒，包含视觉主干网络的完整模型推理则需66.43毫秒。这些结果表明，单步潜在提议生成与直接聚合为多假设运动规划提供了一种高效设计方案。

title: Safe Execution of RL Policies Via Acceleration-Based CBF-QP Constraint Enforcement for Real-World Robotic Deployments
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated remarkable capabilities for solving complex robotic control problems, but its lack of safety guarantees severely limits deployment on hardware. In particular, as legged robots and manipulators often operate near safety-critical boundaries, out-of-distribution states can lead to failure upon deployment. To address this, we introduce Acc-CBF-QP, an acceleration-based Quadratic Program (QP) safety filter using Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) that constrains any RL policy onto a safe set at runtime without modifying training. The method applies to unconstrained and Safe-RL policies, and enforces joint position, velocity, torque, and collision constraints within a unified optimization framework. A key contribution is the formulation of RL+QP tasks that regulate deviation from the RL command when constraints would otherwise be violated. We introduce a TorqueTask, minimizing torque deviation, and a Forward Dynamics Task, minimizing induced acceleration deviation, thus providing principled control over safety-performance trade-offs. Experiments on a 7-DoF Kinova Gen3 manipulator and a 19-DoF Unitree H1 humanoid, both in simulation and on hardware, highlight substantial reductions in constraint violations. On the real H1 hardware, a Safe-RL policy alone yielded 10.04 violations/s, which were reduced by 92% to 0.80 violations/s when augmented with Acc-CBF-QP. On the Kinova Gen3, Acc-CBF-QP fully eliminated violations. Nominal task performance of the RL objective is preserved in violation-free regimes. Under aggressive velocity commands on H1, Acc-CBF-QP improves execution by preventing constraint-induced shutdowns, yielding longer survival times. The full pipeline is open-source.
tldr: This paper proposes Acc-CBF-QP, an acceleration-based quadratic program safety filter that enforces constraints from any RL policy on real legged and manipulator robots, drastically reducing violations without modifying training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Acc-CBF-QP，一种基于加速度的二次规划安全滤波器，可在不修改训练的情况下对任何RL策略施加约束，在真实腿足机器人和机械臂上显著减少违反行为。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）在解决复杂机器人控制问题方面展现出卓越能力，但缺乏安全保证严重限制了其在硬件上的部署。特别是腿式机器人和机械臂常在安全关键边界附近运行时，分布外状态可能导致部署时的故障。为解决这一问题，我们提出Acc-CBF-QP——一种基于加速度的二次规划（QP）安全滤波器，利用控制屏障函数（CBF）在运行时将任意RL策略约束至安全集内，且无需修改训练过程。该方法适用于无约束策略和安全RL策略，并在统一优化框架内强制执行关节位置、速度、扭矩及碰撞约束。核心贡献在于提出了RL+QP任务公式化方法，在约束即将被违反时调节对RL指令的偏离。我们引入最小化扭矩偏离的扭矩任务，以及最小化诱导加速度偏离的前向动力学任务，从而实现对安全-性能权衡的规范化控制。在7自由度Kinova Gen3机械臂和19自由度Unitree H1仿人机器人上的仿真与硬件实验均表明，约束违反次数显著降低。在真实H1硬件上，单独使用安全RL策略产生10.04次违反/秒，而结合Acc-CBF-QP后减少92%至0.80次违反/秒。在Kinova Gen3上，Acc-CBF-QP完全消除了约束违反。RL目标的标称任务性能在无违反区域内得以保持。当H1收到激进速度指令时，Acc-CBF-QP通过防止约束引发的停机来提升执行效果，从而延长存活时间。完整流程已开源。

title: MIDAS Hand: Modular low-Impedance Direct-drive Anthropomorphic Sensing Hand
summary: Dexterous manipulation is limited not only by algorithms but by a shortage of accessible hand hardware that combines human-scale morphology, ease of manufacturing or maintenance, tactile sensing, and practical cost. Existing dexterous hands tend to optimize some of these properties at the expense of others. We present MIDAS Hand, a low-cost, open-source, human-scale dexterous hand with integrated tactile sensing for manipulation research. MIDAS Hand provides 16 total degrees of freedom (DoF) with 13 active DoF, directly driven actuation with measurably low backdrive torque, and 283 three-axis tactile taxels in a compact 700 g package with a bill of materials under 3,000 USD. Built from 3D-printed components, it assembles in under three hours while providing the strength, repeatability, and maintainability needed for repeated real-world experiments. Alongside the hardware, we release a full stack: design files, build documentation, control and tactile Python APIs, simulation models, and retargeting and teleoperation pipelines. We characterize MIDAS Hand through workspace and grasp-taxonomy analysis, payload and reliability tests, backdrivability measurements, and teleoperation demonstrations with tactile sensing, showing that it offers a balanced, reproducible platform for tactile dexterous manipulation and human-to-robot data collection. Project page: https://midas-hand.com
tldr: MIDAS Hand is a low-cost, open-source, human-scale dexterous hand with 16 DoF, tactile sensing, and direct-drive actuation, designed to enable reproducible dexterous manipulation research.
tldr_zh: MIDAS Hand 是一款低成本、开源、人体规模的灵巧手，具有16个自由度、触觉感知和直接驱动，旨在支持可复现的灵巧操作研究。
summary_zh: 灵巧操作不仅受限于算法，更受制于缺乏一种兼具人类尺度形态、易于制造或维护、触觉感应功能以及实际成本可控的可用手部硬件。现有灵巧手往往牺牲某些特性来优化其他方面。我们提出MIDAS手——一种低成本、开源、人类尺度的灵巧手，集成了触觉感应能力，专为操作研究设计。MIDAS手提供总计16个自由度（DoF），其中13个主动自由度，采用直接驱动方式，具有可测量的低反向驱动力矩，在紧凑的700克封装内集成283个三轴触觉感知单元，物料成本低于3000美元。该手采用3D打印部件制成，组装时间不超过三小时，同时具备重复真实实验所需的强度、重复性和可维护性。除硬件外，我们还发布了完整技术栈：设计文件、构建文档、控制与触觉Python API、仿真模型，以及重定向与遥操作管道。我们通过工作空间与抓取分类分析、负载与可靠性测试、反向驱动能力测量以及带触觉感应的遥操作演示对MIDAS手进行了表征，结果显示其为触觉灵巧操作以及人-机器人数据收集提供了一个均衡、可复现的平台。项目页面：https://midas-hand.com

title: Chat2Scenic: An Iterative RAG-Based Framework for Scenario Generation in Autonomous Driving
summary: Validating autonomous driving systems requires diverse, regulation-compliant test scenarios. In simulation-based testing, scenarios are defined as executable scripts. Yet automatically generating such scripts from regulatory descriptions remains an open challenge, and existing approaches face fundamental trade-offs. Retrieval-assemble methods achieve reasonable compilation rates but lack scalability, whereas retrieval-based full-script generation suffers from low compilation success rates. We present Chat2Scenic, the first iterative retrieval-augmented framework to generate scenario scripts in Domain Specific Language (DSL). Specifically, Chat2Scenic provides a chatbot interface that supports interactive scenario refinement and integrates Retrieval-augmented Generation (RAG) to ground scenario generation in regulatory knowledge and DSL syntax. Furthermore, we propose an open benchmark for scenario generation comprising 123 scenarios from various regulations, including NHTSA and United Nations Vehicle Regulations, as well as other sources. Extensive evaluation with State-of-the-Art (SOTA) Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrates that Chat2Scenic achieves 76.42% Compilation Success Rate (CSR) and 58.17% Framework Accuracy (FA), outperforming existing methods (Retrieval Assemble with 30.08% CSR, 11.03% FA and Retrieval full script generation with 16.26% CSR, 10.86% FA). To facilitate future research, we release our code as open source at https://github.com/TUM-AVS/chat2scenic.
tldr: Chat2Scenic introduces an iterative RAG-based framework for generating executable DSL scenario scripts from regulatory text for autonomous driving simulation, significantly outperforming prior retrieval-based methods on a new benchmark of 123 scenarios.
tldr_zh: Chat2Scenic 提出了一种基于迭代 RAG 的框架，能够从法规文本自动生成可执行的 DSL 场景脚本用于自动驾驶仿真，在包含 123 个场景的新基准上显著优于以往的检索方法。
summary_zh: 验证自动驾驶系统需要多样化且符合法规的测试场景。在基于仿真的测试中，场景被定义为可执行的脚本。然而，从法规描述中自动生成此类脚本仍是一项开放性挑战，现有方法面临根本性的权衡问题。检索-组装方法虽能达到合理的编译成功率，但缺乏可扩展性；而基于检索的完整脚本生成方法则存在编译成功率低的问题。我们提出Chat2Scenic——首个用于生成领域特定语言（DSL）场景脚本的迭代式检索增强框架。具体而言，Chat2Scenic提供了支持交互式场景优化的聊天机器人界面，并集成了检索增强生成（RAG）技术，使场景生成基于法规知识和DSL语法。此外，我们提出了一套开放的场景生成基准测试，包含来自不同法规（包括美国国家公路交通安全管理局及联合国车辆法规等来源）的123个场景。基于最先进大语言模型的广泛评估表明，Chat2Scenic实现了76.42%的编译成功率（CSR）和58.17%的框架准确率（FA），优于现有方法（检索-组装方法：CSR为30.08%，FA为11.03%；检索式完整脚本生成方法：CSR为16.26%，FA为10.86%）。为促进后续研究，我们在https://github.com/TUM-AVS/chat2scenic开源了代码。

title: Beyond Visual Grasping: Benchmarking Complex Grasping from Detection to Execution
summary: Robust robotic grasping remains a fundamental challenge for complex real-world applications. Recent advances in large-scale models demonstrate promising capabilities for reasoning in robotic tasks. However, existing benchmarks for grasping primarily focus on isolated, visual-based grasp pose detection, failing to capture the complexity of grasping tasks that require multi-step reasoning and semantic understanding during execution. To address this gap, we propose GCA-Bench, a benchmark featuring challenging \textit{grasping with complex action} scenarios that involve both scene-level reasoning and semantic constraints. GCA-Bench enables the evaluation of recent large foundation models under the same settings. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our new benchmark, we implement a diverse set of baselines, ranging from traditional grasp detection pipelines to end-to-end learning methods. Empirical studies achieve success rates below 70\% on complex grasping scenarios, underscoring critical limitations. In addition, we propose new evaluation metrics, analyze critical failure models, and provide insights to guide the development of more robust and generalizable grasping strategies.
tldr: Proposes GCA-Bench, a benchmark for complex robotic grasping that requires scene-level reasoning and semantic constraints, evaluating multiple baselines and revealing limitations below 70% success rate.
tldr_zh: 提出了GCA-Bench，这是一个针对需要场景级推理和语义约束的复杂机器人抓取任务的基准，评估了多种基线方法并揭示了低于70%的成功率的局限性。
summary_zh: 鲁棒机器人抓取仍然是复杂实际应用中的一项基本挑战。近期大规模模型的进展展现出在机器人任务中进行推理的广阔能力。然而，现有抓取基准主要关注孤立的、基于视觉的抓取姿态检测，未能涵盖需要多步推理和执行过程中语义理解的复杂抓取任务。为填补这一空白，我们提出了GCA-Bench，一个包含具有挑战性的“复杂动作抓取”场景的基准，该场景涉及场景级推理与语义约束。GCA-Bench能够在相同设置下评估近期大型基础模型。为验证新基准的有效性，我们实现了从传统抓取检测流程到端到端学习方法的多种基线方法。实验表明，在复杂抓取场景中成功率低于70%，凸显了关键局限性。此外，我们提出了新的评估指标，分析了关键失败模式，并提供了相关见解，以指导更鲁棒、更具泛化性的抓取策略的开发。

title: DiMaS: Distribution Matching for Steering Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful policies for robotic manipulation, yet a critical capability remains underexplored: fine-grained behavioral control, the ability to govern how a robot performs a task by intervening on its internal representations. Representation steering is a well-established interpretability tool for language and vision-language models, where behavioral features are typically encoded as linear directions, but we show that these classic methods fall short in VLAs. We propose DiMaS, a Distribution-Matching Steering strategy tailored to flow-matching VLAs, which transports between representation distributions rather than shifting along a fixed direction, and show that it effectively controls behavior across two state-of-the-art VLAs. We further examine the generalizability of this strategy as the tasks it is learned from and evaluated on grow increasingly dissimilar, characterizing where behavioral control transfers and where it weakens. Finally, through an analysis of the representation structure of the action expert, we explain why classical linear steering falls short in the visuomotor setting: behavioral features are linearly decodable but not linearly steerable, which motivates the distribution-matching design of DiMaS. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pegah-kh/dimas, with additional results and videos at https://pegah-kh.github.io/dimas/
tldr: Proposes DiMaS, a distribution-matching steering method for flow-matching VLA models to enable fine-grained behavioral control, demonstrating that it outperforms linear steering and analyzing why linear methods fail in visuomotor settings.
tldr_zh: 提出DiMaS，一种针对流匹配VLA模型的分布匹配操控方法，实现细粒度行为控制，证明其优于线性操控，并分析了线性方法在视觉运动场景中失效的原因。
summary_zh: 基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为机器人操作领域的强大策略，但一项关键能力仍未得到充分探索：细粒度行为控制，即通过干预模型内部表征来调控机器人执行任务的方式。表征引导是语言和视觉-语言模型中成熟的解释性工具，其行为特征通常编码为线性方向，但我们发现这些经典方法在VLA中效果有限。为此，我们提出DiMaS——一种针对流匹配VLA的分布匹配引导策略。该方法通过在表征分布之间迁移而非沿固定方向移动来实现控制，并证明其能有效调控两个最先进VLA模型的行为。我们进一步考察了该策略的泛化能力，研究当学习与评估任务差异逐渐增大时，行为控制何时可迁移、何时被弱化。最后，通过分析动作专家的表征结构，我们揭示了经典线性引导在视觉运动场景中失效的原因：行为特征虽然可线性解码，却无法线性引导——这正构成了DiMaS分布匹配方法的设计动机。我们的代码已开源至https://github.com/pegah-kh/dimas，更多结果与视频见https://pegah-kh.github.io/dimas/。

title: MEMORA: Embodied Action Memory from Egocentric Videos for Reasoning and Planning
summary: Long-horizon robot planning requires more than predicting what actions will do next; it also requires memory of the embodied experience that makes future goals interpretable. People do not plan from the present scene alone: they draw on remembered places, object-state changes, prior procedures, and regularities revealed through repeated action. We formulate Embodied Action Memory (EAM) as the capability to form, maintain, and use such experience as a persistent memory state for later decisions. MEMORA realizes EAM with a formation-consolidation-retrieval lifecycle and four typed stores: Environment Memory, Entity Memory, Activity Memory, and Inferred Knowledge. Online editing maintains object identities and state histories as new observations arrive; offline consolidation abstracts repeated experience into reusable procedures and participant-specific regularities. MEMORA-Bench evaluates this lifecycle on 45 hours of EPIC-KITCHENS-100 extension video across 18 participants through memory-grounded planning, including previously unseen goals, and a complementary memory-assessment task. Across four open-weight language models, full MEMORA--combining editing, typed stores, and consolidation--achieves the strongest aggregate results among the evaluated memory conditions. It improves memory-assessment accuracy by up to 20.5 points over the strongest controlled baseline and improves out-of-distribution Robot-Grounded Plan score by up to 16.6% relative. A qualitative two-task robot deployment study further illustrates how memory-grounded language plans can interface with downstream control, while the overall results show that editable, consolidated memory can supply remembered context for robot planning. Project page: https://yuzihaowashu.github.io/MEMORA/
tldr: MEMORA introduces Embodied Action Memory (EAM) with a lifecycle of formation, consolidation, and retrieval using four typed memory stores, enabling long-horizon robot planning from egocentric videos.
tldr_zh: MEMORA提出了具身动作记忆（EAM），通过形成、巩固和检索的生命周期以及四种类型记忆存储，实现了从自我中心视频进行长时程机器人规划。
summary_zh: 长时域机器人规划不仅需要预测动作的后续效果，还需要记忆具身经验，使未来目标具有可解释性。人类并非仅凭当前场景进行规划：他们会调用记忆中的位置、物体状态变化、先前流程以及通过重复动作所揭示的规律。我们提出具身动作记忆（EAM）的概念，将其定义为形成、维护并利用此类经验作为持久记忆状态以支持后续决策的能力。MEMORA系统通过构建-巩固-检索的生命周期及四种类型存储实现EAM：环境记忆、实体记忆、活动记忆与推断知识。在线编辑机制在新观测数据到达时维护物体身份与状态历史；离线巩固机制将重复经验抽象为可复用流程及参与者特定规律。MEMORA-Bench基于18名参与者的45小时EPIC-KITCHENS-100扩展视频，通过记忆支撑型规划（涵盖未见目标）及补充性记忆评估任务，对此生命周期进行评测。在四种开源语言模型上，完整的MEMORA系统（集成编辑、类型化存储与巩固机制）在所有受测记忆条件中取得了最强综合结果：相较最强受控基线，记忆评估准确率提升最高达20.5个百分点，分布外机器人基础规划得分相对提升16.6%。定性双任务机器人部署研究进一步展示了记忆支撑型语言规划如何与下游控制对接，整体结果表明，可编辑、可巩固的记忆能够为机器人规划提供记忆情境。项目主页：https://yuzihaowashu.github.io/MEMORA/

title: Never Too Late for Force: Accelerating VLA Post-Training with Reactive Force Injection
summary: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong language-conditioned manipulation knowledge, but they remain largely vision-driven and can struggle once manipulation enters contact states where the scene is occluded, depth is ambiguous, or small force errors push execution off the offline demonstration distribution. We present LIFT (Late Reactive Injection of Force for VLA Post-Training), a force-aware post-training framework that adds contact reactivity to a pretrained VLA policy while preserving its general manipulation knowledge. LIFT grafts a reactive action expert beside the original action expert, initializes it from pretrained action weights, and injects recent 6D end-effector force through causal force memory and zero-initialized cross attention, enabling actions to be refreshed during execution. To address the policy-dependent distribution shift of contact feedback, LIFT further couples reactive force injection with an online DAgger loop that trains on a mixture of offline task-alignment data and human-corrected online rollouts. Across towel folding, book insertion, and Hanoi ring placement, LIFT learns faster and reaches higher performance than vision-only post-training, while ablations show that reactive force memory and online corrective data are both important for robust contact-rich manipulation. Our code and data will be publicly available.
tldr: LIFT injects reactive force feedback into pretrained VLA policies via a grafted force-aware action expert and online DAgger training, significantly improving contact-rich manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: LIFT 通过嫁接力感知动作专家和在线 DAgger 训练，将反应式力反馈注入预训练的 VLA 策略，显著提升了接触丰富的操作性能。
summary_zh: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略具备强大的语言条件化操作知识，但其本质仍以视觉驱动为主，一旦操作进入接触状态（场景遮挡、深度模糊或微小力误差导致执行偏离离线演示分布），便会陷入困境。本文提出LIFT（面向VLA后训练的力反应延迟注入框架），该力感知后训练框架在为预训练VLA策略增加接触反应能力的同时，保持其通用操作知识。LIFT在原始动作专家旁嫁接一个反应式动作专家，通过预训练动作权重初始化，并借助因果力记忆与零初始化交叉注意力机制注入近期六维末端执行器力信息，使动作能够在执行过程中动态刷新。为解决接触反馈中策略相关的分布偏移问题，LIFT进一步将反应式力注入与在线DAgger循环耦合，该循环在离线任务对齐数据与人工修正的在线轨迹混合数据上进行训练。在毛巾折叠、书本插入与河内塔环放置任务中，LIFT的收敛速度与最终性能均优于纯视觉后训练方法。消融实验表明，反应式力记忆与在线修正数据对于鲁棒的接触密集型操作均至关重要。我们的代码与数据将公开提供。

title: WorkDrive: Roadwork Chain of Causation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving vision-language models (VLMs) struggle in roadwork zones, where familiar visual cues such as lane markings and permanent signs are altered or absent, and temporary devices such as cones and barriers redefine the drivable corridor. VLMs can detect these objects, but without explicit guidance they anchor their reasoning on familiar elements from pre-training and fail to connect work-zone observations to correct planning decisions. We propose WorkDrive, a framework that constructs perception-grounded causal reasoning for work zones and aligns it with trajectory prediction. An automated multitask perception pipeline extracts structured scene facts and injects them into a Chain-of-Causation (CoC) annotation pipeline, redirecting the annotator's attention to domain-specific elements. The resulting reasoning labels are used for supervised fine-tuning, followed by reinforcement learning with a single reward: consistency between lateral meta-actions and the predicted trajectory. On ROADWork, the largest public work-zone dataset, the proposed roadwork CoC reduces trajectory average displacement error (ADE) by 9.0\%, and consistency-based GRPO yields a further 3.0\%, achieving progressive improvement over the trajectory-only baseline. Code and data will be publicly released.
tldr: WorkDrive introduces a Chain-of-Causation framework that injects perception-grounded causal reasoning into VLM-based autonomous driving, improving trajectory prediction in roadwork zones via supervised fine-tuning and consistency-based reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: WorkDrive提出了一个因果链框架，将感知驱动的因果推理注入基于VLM的自动驾驶中，通过监督微调和基于一致性的强化学习改善了施工区域的轨迹预测。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶视觉-语言模型（VLM）在道路施工区域面临挑战：此类区域中车道标线和永久性标志等常见视觉线索被改变或缺失，而锥桶和护栏等临时设施重新定义了可行驶通道。VLM虽能检测到这些物体，但缺乏明确指引时，其推理会锚定预训练阶段习得的常规要素，导致无法将施工区域观测结果与正确的规划决策相关联。我们提出WorkDrive框架，该框架构建了面向施工区域的感知驱动因果推理机制，并将其与轨迹预测对齐。自动化多任务感知流程提取结构化场景事实，并将其注入因果链（CoC）标注流程，引导标注者聚焦领域特异性元素。由此产生的推理标签用于监督微调，继而通过单一奖励（横向元动作与预测轨迹的一致性）进行强化学习。在最大公开施工区域数据集ROADWork上，所提出的道路施工CoC使轨迹平均位移误差（ADE）降低9.0%，基于一致性的GRPO进一步降低3.0%，在纯轨迹基线基础上实现逐步提升。代码与数据将公开发布。

title: 3D Lane Detection with Odometry for High-Speed Vehicle Racing
summary: Lane boundary detection is a critical component in autonomous driving systems and has been rigorously studied in regular driving scenarios. However, it is less explored in vehicle racing, where the car moves at higher speeds across more extreme road geometries. To study this problem, we introduce a new dataset for 3D lane detection in racing, featuring >$250$k images from multiple camera feeds and inertial measurements taken with a Lexus LC 500 driving on a closed circuit. With this dataset, we compare various approaches to 3D lane detection and propose modifications that permit frames to be processed at rates of almost 300Hz while retaining high predictive performance in the racing application. This facilitates a multi-camera ensemble approach that is validated on hardware. We show that sensing modalities such as inertial measurements can be leveraged for pre-integration to regress road geometries over both cameras and time, yielding improvements in key metrics. Compared to methods such as BevLaneDet, adding odometry and ensemble predictions improves the F1 score by 3 points and reduces near-vehicle mean absolute errors (MAEs) by $>30 \%$. We show F1 scores $>$0.9 and lateral MAEs of $<$0.18m in vehicle deployments.
tldr: A 3D lane detection dataset and method for high-speed racing, leveraging odometry and multi-camera ensembles to achieve real-time performance (∼300 Hz) with improved F1 and MAE metrics.
tldr_zh: 提出用于高速赛车场景的3D车道检测数据集和方法，利用里程计和多相机集成实现近300Hz的实时处理，在F1和MAE指标上取得显著提升。
summary_zh: 车道边界检测是自动驾驶系统的关键组成部分，且在常规驾驶场景中已得到深入研究。然而，在车辆以更高速度行驶于更极端道路几何形状的赛车场景中，相关研究相对较少。为探究这一问题，我们引入了一个用于赛车场景中3D车道检测的新数据集，该数据集包含来自多摄像头视角的超过25万张图像，以及在一辆雷克萨斯LC 500在封闭赛道上行驶时采集的惯性测量数据。基于该数据集，我们比较了多种3D车道检测方法，并提出了改进方案，使得帧处理速率可达近300Hz，同时在赛车应用中保持高预测性能。这有助于实现一种多摄像头集成方法，并在硬件上得到验证。研究表明，惯性测量等感知模态可被用于预积分，以回归摄像头和时间维度上的道路几何形状，从而在关键指标上取得改进。与BevLaneDet等方法相比，加入里程计与集成预测使F1分数提升了3个百分点，并将近车平均绝对误差（MAEs）降低了超过30%。在车辆实际部署中，我们展示了超过0.9的F1分数以及低于0.18米的横向平均绝对误差。

title: AHEAD: Anticipatory Hand-Driven Teleoperation via Human Intent Prediction
summary: Direct hand-driven teleoperation maps an operator's hand motion to robot end-effector commands at every frame, enabling precise control, but it requires constant monitoring and correction during approach, grasp, and placement, which can be slow and fatiguing. For repetitive pick-and-place tasks, supervisory (goal-based) teleoperation simplifies this process: the operator specifies goals/waypoints, and the robot executes the motion using planning algorithms. Yet, this introduces latency, as the robot must wait for the next command before it can plan and act. "How can we reduce robot reaction time while lowering operator workload?" To tackle this question, we present AHEAD, a real-time VR teleoperation system that anticipates operator intent to enable proactive, hand-driven control. In a digital twin, the operator performs pick-and-place naturally, using hand motion to convey high-level commands rather than a continuous robot trajectory. AHEAD processes a short window of 3D hand and head signals together with scene context through an attention-based classifier to predict the intended grasp object and placement slot. A state machine converts intent predictions into stable robot goals, enabling early motion while remaining stable under noisy predictions and corrective hand movements. AHEAD's intent prediction module achieves Top1 accuracy: 76% for grasp objects and 76% for target slots. Moreover, our user study shows AHEAD reduces robot reaction latency by 0.6 s (object) and 1.4 s (slot) relative to baselines. Participants also reported lower operator load, indicating faster robot responses while maintaining low operator effort in practice.
tldr: AHEAD is a VR teleoperation system that predicts operator intent from hand/head signals and scene context to reduce robot reaction latency in repetitive pick-and-place tasks.
tldr_zh: AHEAD 是一个VR遥操作系统，通过手部/头部信号和场景上下文预测操作员意图，从而减少重复拾放任务中的机器人反应延迟。
summary_zh: 直接手控遥操作将操作员的手部运动实时映射为机器人末端执行器的指令，从而实现精确控制，但在接近、抓取和放置过程中需要持续监控和修正，可能造成操作缓慢且易疲劳。对于重复性拾放任务，监督式（基于目标设定）遥操作简化了这一流程：操作员指定目标点/路径点，机器人通过规划算法执行运动。然而，这种方式会引入延迟——机器人必须等待下一个指令才能进行规划与执行。"如何能在降低操作员工作负荷的同时缩短机器人响应时间？"为解决这一问题，我们提出AHEAD系统——一种能够预判操作员意图以实现主动式手控的实时虚拟现实遥操作系统。在数字孪生环境中，操作员以自然方式完成拾放任务，通过手部运动传递高级指令而非连续机器人轨迹。AHEAD通过基于注意力机制的分类器，处理短时窗口内的三维手部与头部信号及场景上下文，预测目标抓取物体与放置槽位。状态机将意图预测转化为稳定的机器人目标，在存在噪声预测与修正手部运动的情况下仍能实现早期运动补偿。AHEAD的意图预测模块在抓取物体与目标槽位上的Top1准确率均达76%。用户研究表明，相比基准方法，AHEAD将机器人响应延迟分别缩短了0.6秒（物体）与1.4秒（槽位）。参与者反馈操作负荷降低，表明系统在实际应用中既能提升机器人响应速度，又能维持低操作员工作投入。

title: Catch, Throw, Repeat: Planning for Human-Robot Partner Juggling
summary: Dynamic object exchange between humans and robots remains a challenging problem due to uncertainty in perception, timing, and contact-rich interaction. Human-robot juggling represents a particularly demanding instance of this problem, requiring precise real-time coordination, predictive motion planning with feedback control, and robustness to variability in human motion. Enabling such skills is of interest for advancing physical human-robot interaction and shared autonomy. We present a real-time planning and control architecture for human-robot partner juggling that enables a robot to reliably catch and throw balls in synchronized multi-ball patterns with a human partner. The system integrates predictive ball tracking, adaptive online trajectory optimization using a multiple-shooting formulation, and a state-machine-based coordination logic to enable synchronized multi-ball human-robot partner juggling. In a user study with 8 participants of varying juggling skill from beginner to expert, we demonstrate that our system can achieve three-ball cascades shared between the robot and the human. All participants exceeded previously reported best-case results within a 10-minute test session, with one participant extending the previous record for shared three-ball cascade juggling fivefold to 20 consecutive robot catches, and another participant achieving a 100% success rate with 40 consecutive catches in a single-ball catch-and-return setting. Video documentation can be found at https://kai-ploeger.com/partner-juggling
tldr: A real-time planning and control architecture enabling a robot to reliably catch and throw balls in synchronized multi-ball patterns with a human partner, demonstrated in a user study achieving three-ball cascade juggling.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种实时规划与控制架构，使机器人能够与人类伙伴可靠地接扔球并完成同步多球模式，用户研究展示了三球级联杂技。
summary_zh: 人机之间的动态物品交换因感知、时序和接触密集交互中的不确定性而仍具挑战性。人机合作抛接球作为该问题的一个典型高难度实例，要求精确的实时协调、结合反馈控制的预测性运动规划，以及对人类运动变异性的鲁棒性。实现此类技能对于推动物理性人机交互与共享自主性具有重要意义。我们提出了一种用于人机合作抛接球的实时规划与控制架构，使机器人能够与人类搭档可靠地接住和抛出球，并实现同步的多球模式。该系统集成了预测性球体追踪、基于多目标规划公式的自适应在线轨迹优化，以及基于状态机的协调逻辑，从而支持同步多球人机合作抛接球。在8名抛接球技能水平从初学者到专家不一的参与者开展的用户研究中，我们证明该系统能够实现机器人与人类共享的三球级联抛接。所有参与者在10分钟的测试环节中均超越了此前报道的最佳结果，其中一名参与者将此前共享三球级联抛接的记录延长五倍，实现了机器人连续接球20次；另一名单球接发场景下的参与者则实现了40次连续接球100%的成功率。视频文档详见 https://kai-ploeger.com/partner-juggling。

title: Goal-Oriented Semantic Communication for Distributed ISAC-Enabled Vehicle Coordination
summary: Vehicle coordination at unsignalized intersections relies on accurate real-time vehicle state acquisition and reliable command-and-control (C&C) signal delivery. However, existing studies typically treat sensing, communication, and control separately, which may lead to redundant transmissions, outdated state information, and unreliable vehicle coordination. In this paper, we investigate a new scenario of distributed integrated sensing and communication (ISAC)-enabled vehicle coordination at intersections, where multiple roadside units (RSUs) collaboratively transmit sensing signals for vehicle state acquisition and C&C signals for vehicle movement control under the management of a central base station (BS). To improve signaling efficiency, we propose a unified goal-oriented semantic communication (GSC) framework, which transmits sensing and C&C signals only when they are semantically important for improving intersection traffic throughput. Specifically, an extended Kalman filter (EKF) is adopted to predict vehicle states and fuse distributed sensing measurements. A masked hybrid proximal policy optimization (MHPPO) framework is then developed to jointly determine sensing transmission decisions, C&C transmission decisions, and C&C signal contents based on a value-of-information (VoI) reward. Furthermore, we propose an uncertainty-aware transmission design (UTD), including robust beamforming and VoI-based time-division power allocation, to improve sensing and communication reliability under vehicle state uncertainty and inter-RSU interference. Simulation results show that our proposed framework achieves 100% collision-free vehicle coordination with significantly reduced signaling overhead compared with predictive ISAC baselines adapted from state-of-the-art related studies and several ablation baselines.
tldr: This paper proposes a goal-oriented semantic communication framework for distributed ISAC-enabled vehicle coordination at unsignalized intersections, using EKF for state prediction and masked hybrid PPO for joint sensing, command-and-control decisions, achieving 100% collision-free coordination with reduced signaling overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向目标的语义通信框架，用于无信号交叉口的分布式ISAC车辆协调，利用EKF进行状态预测和掩码混合PPO进行联合感知、命令与控制决策，在降低信令开销的同时实现了100%无碰撞协调。
summary_zh: 无信号交叉口的车辆协同依赖于高精度的实时车辆状态获取与可靠的指挥控制（C&C）指令传输。然而，现有研究通常将感知、通信和控制分开处理，可能导致冗余传输、状态信息滞后以及车辆协同不可靠。本文研究了一种新型分布式集成感知与通信（ISAC）使能的交叉口车辆协同场景——在中心基站（BS）管理下，多个路侧单元（RSU）协同传输用于车辆状态获取的感知信号及用于车辆运动控制的C&C信号。为提升信令效率，我们提出了统一的目标导向语义通信（GSC）框架，仅当感知信号和C&C信号对提升交叉口交通吞吐量具有语义重要性时才进行传输。具体而言，采用扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）预测车辆状态并融合分布式感知测量值；进而开发了掩膜混合近端策略优化（MHPPO）框架，基于信息价值（VoI）奖励联合决策感知传输策略、C&C传输策略及C&C信号内容。此外，我们提出了不确定性感知传输设计（UTD），包括鲁棒波束成形与基于VoI的时分功率分配，以在车辆状态不确定性与RSU间干扰条件下提升感知与通信可靠性。仿真结果表明，与基于最新相关研究改进的预测式ISAC基线及多种消融基线相比，所提框架在显著降低信令开销的同时，实现了100%无碰撞的车辆协同。

title: KineFuse: Kinematic-Aware Haptic Fusion for In-Hand Occluded-Object Pose Tracking
summary: Dexterous in-hand manipulation requires continuous 6D pose tracking, yet the manipulating fingers inevitably occlude the object from the camera. We study how to structure the sparse haptic signals already available on multi-fingered hands, including proprioception, proximal force/torque, and binary contact, to complement a pretrained visual pose tracker under occlusion. We propose a kinematic-aware finger-level encoder and systematically compare it against four alternative designs through three levels of evaluation: per-frame refinement, sequential open-loop tracking, and closed-loop manipulation. Our experiments reveal that (i) per-frame evaluation cannot distinguish encoder quality, while sequential tracking amplifies architectural differences by up to 15 times; (ii) the structured encoder learns task-specific cross-modal gating, using vision exclusively for translation and dedicating one attention head to haptics for rotation, without explicit supervision; and (iii) compact finger-level tokenization with 4 tokens outperforms both flat fusion and joint-level representations, which suppress vision through norm dominance. We validate that improved tracking yields higher success in a downstream reorientation task and provide qualitative real-world demonstrations. Our project page is available at https://cold-young.github.io/kine-fuse/.
tldr: KineFuse proposes a kinematic-aware haptic fusion method that structures sparse tactile signals to improve 6D pose tracking of occluded objects during dexterous in-hand manipulation.
tldr_zh: KineFuse 提出了一种运动学感知的触觉融合方法，通过结构化稀疏触觉信号，改善灵巧手内操作中被遮挡物体的 6D 位姿跟踪。
